title: aira lagopoides
intro: Aira lagopoides, commonly known as Velvet Bent or Velvet Hairgrass, is a species of flowering plant in the grass family Poaceae. It is native to Europe and Western Asia and has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits. The plant is said to possess therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may aid in reducing stress and promoting overall well-being. Bioactive constituents present in Aira lagopoides include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
